sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with a recent sequence of WIN-DRAW-WIN-WIN-WIN, and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who occupy bottom spot with just 4 points from 10 matches and are on a concerning run of five losses in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in a fixture that offers the visitors a chance to climb the table—Stafford have dropped points recently (D-W-W-L-W-D) while Dawley sit mid-table with mixed form. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in-form, travel to Eccleshall in a battle between mid-table sides, with Bridgnorth having recovered from a recent loss to record four consecutive wins. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain struggling Wednesfield Community; both sides have inconsistent records but Casuals' recent WIN gives them an edge. Third-placed Bilston Town, currently on form with W-W-D-W-D-W, host Foley Meir in a clash of mid-table teams. Crewe, languishing near the bottom with just 9 points, face Allscott Heath (11 points) in a relegation-zone battle. Market Drayton Town, on a mixed run, visit high-flying New Mills, who have endured recent struggles (L-L-D-L-W-D). Shawbury United, winless in their last five, welcome Barnton, who showed recovery with a recent win after inconsistent form. Finally, Cheadle Heath Nomads, drawing their last two, travel to Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the division's lowest-scoring sides.
